assertion_review.io_events: Each wait requires PRI and rejects ERR/HUP (poll also NVAL); observed flags exactly 0x2. Both cgroup some poll and full epoll notify again after read/rearm.
assertion_review.real_io_wait: Worker uses O_DIRECT pread with a buffer overwritten by 0xa5 before each operation and verifies zero-filled guest loop data. 2MiB took 7.975 seconds under 256KiB/s throttle.
assertion_review.cpu_migration: For eight operations, worker was D before and remained D after affinity plus cgroup change; the same in-flight operation then completed on the requested different CPU. Wchan identifies __blkdev_direct_IO_simple.
assertion_review.cgroup_migration: A/B membership alternated via checked cgroup.procs writes, while the worker stayed in the v1 blkio throttle group; A and B each recorded positive some/full totals.
assertion_review.bounded_scope: One IO child, 8MiB loop image on a 16MiB guest tmpfs, no network or host disks; parent watchdog 45s and child watchdog 35s.

supersedes_prior_limits: Actual IO pressure some/full event generation and rearm are now verified.
Deliberate cross-CPU IO-stalled wake migration is now verified.
remaining_limits: Memory-reclaim/refault-stalled cross-CPU migration is not covered by this IO workload.
Real hardware/storage performance is not tested.
A bounded test does not prove absence of every possible scheduler or lifetime race.
